description: Permits a six-unit residential building at 1401 11th Street West.
This rezoning allows higher density than current rules permit.

chips.text: Defeated
Councillor Derek argued current policy is not flexible enough for larger corner sites.
Residents of the Holiday Park neighborhood.
Administration recommended denial, but the motion to deny was defeated.
Administration warned approval would set a precedent for intensification outside transit areas.
69 of 75 public respondents and the Holiday Park Community Association opposed the rezoning.
One councillor voted for denial, citing community opposition and parking concerns.

description: Rezoning 1401 11th Street West from R2 to RM2 proposed.

Development incompatible with neighborhood height and scale.

chips.text: 69 respondents opposed, 6 supported the rezoning

description: Prairie Board of Governments proposes six-unit dwelling.

No risk of speculation; site limited to six dwellings.

description: Applicant explained choice of six units due to financing.

segments.title: Holiday Park Community Association objects
description: Proposed six-unit development is out of character.
Concerns about setting a precedent for demolition of smaller homes.

Safety concerns and property maintenance issues were raised.

chips.text: Community association objects to rezoning due to character and safety
Residents of Holiday Park concerned about safety and property values

description: Community association discussed limited dialogue with applicant.
